verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a first-party JMAP API with session discovery, token/OAuth auth, batched query/fetch/send and push, which covers core mail operations; the RFCs referenced (8620, 8621, 9610) indicate mail and related data. Nothing in the evidence shows UI-level parity for features such as filters/rules, masked email, aliases, scheduled send, snooze or account settings. missing for 10: evidence that UI features beyond core mail (filters, masked email, aliases, scheduled send, snooze, settings) are exposed via the API, an explicit parity statement, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
